hypothesis_assessments.contradicting_evidence: Dedup reduces less volume than language in every sample, and less token volume than URL in Datasets 2 and 3. The full conjunction is not supported.
hypothesis_assessments.statistical_conclusion: The original significantly-higher claim is not established; no valid population test was performed.
hypothesis_assessments.supporting_evidence: Quality reduces both documents and tokens more than URL and language in all three samples; dedup removes more documents than URL in all three.

hypothesis_assessments.contradicting_evidence: Quality mean sentence lengths decrease in every sample. The longer-sentence claim depends on the location summary, not a uniform rightward shift.
hypothesis_assessments.statistical_conclusion: No distributional equivalence margin or valid inferential design; small dedup distances do not prove equality.
hypothesis_assessments.supporting_evidence: Quality medians rise and SD/IQR/CV decline in all three samples; dedup medians and quartiles are unchanged, with small observed CDF changes.

hypothesis_assessments.contradicting_evidence: Raw richness loss is confounded by retained size; quality survivors occupy distinct hostnames and do not lose richness beyond the same-size uniform-deletion expectation.
hypothesis_assessments.statistical_conclusion: No low-resource/non-standard-domain labels were defined or validated, so that original mechanism is inconclusive; no population significance is claimed.
hypothesis_assessments.supporting_evidence: Language and quality have much greater raw hostname/entropy loss than dedup across all three samples.

statistical_test_decisions.reason: Discrete sentences nested within documents; filtered sets overlap baselines; independent-sample assumptions fail.
Only three nonrepresentative datasets, heterogeneous sampling, five archive windows and repeated content; not independent exchangeable population replicates.
Sentence IID would create pseudoreplication; only one/two archive windows per dataset cannot support defensible archive-level population uncertainty.
Deterministic cleanup on selected nonrandom documents; no justified independent symmetric/random-sign null. Paired descriptive changes are reported.
